ruleDefinitions.name: Potentially Suspicious Ping/Copy Command Combination
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon and potentially suspicious one-liner command containing both "ping" and "copy" at the same time, which is usually used by malware.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*ping.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*copy\\ .*")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-n\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-y\\ .*"))
